segments.name: Hong Kong Trading
segments.description: Trades flanges, fittings and other steel piping products sourced from suppliers, serving manufacturers and traders worldwide.
segments.evidence: Hong Kong Trading mainly represents trading of flanges and fittings products sourced from suppliers and this operating segment is conducted through Luda HK.

segments.name: PRC Manufacturing
segments.description: Manufactures in-house stainless steel and carbon steel flanges and fittings at its China factory and sells them to industrial customers.
segments.evidence: PRC Manufacturing is the largest business segment of the Company that contributes approximately 73.3%, 83.8% and 89.4% of the total revenue in FY2025, FY2024 and FY2023, respectively and represents trading and manufacturing of our inhouse flanges and fittings products.

revenueModel.text: Manufacturers and traders in the chemical, petrochemical, maritime and manufacturing industries pay for steel flanges, fittings, pipes and valves.
revenueModel.evidence: our customers comprise manufacturers and traders from the chemical, petrochemical, maritime and manufacturing industries.
